name: Swap mutation instead of inversion
lesson: Exchanging two cities changes up to four edges where reversing a slice changes at most two, and it is much slower here.
lookFor: Same instance, seed and starting population as “berlin52: the nearest neighbour and the optimum”. At generation 200 the best tour is 74.7 % over the optimum (inversion: 37.6 %) and at 500 it is 44.6 % over (16.6 %). Over seeds 1 to 30 the swap run is behind the inversion run at generation 200 in 29 runs and at 300 and 500 in all 30.
